verdict.rationale: Suppression is a fair axis for an email platform like Brevo. However, the evidence pack never mentions automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, or spam complaints, nor suppression being honored across transactional and marketing sends. The only nearby item is real-time webhook notifications about email events (brevo-docs-3), which is an adjacent building block rather than automatic suppression, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
